new_learnings.text: IV rank at 1.0 across 科创50, 创业板ETF, 深100ETF, and 50ETF is historically extreme panic. The avg IV rank of 0.80 and avg IV percentile of 0.84 are in the top 2% of readings. Historically these mark near-term bottoms (1-2 weeks), but entering DURING the panic spike guarantees getting chopped by gap risk. The buy gate rule correctly forces patience — the opportunity comes AFTER IV peaks and breadth improves, not during.
new_learnings.mechanism: Extreme IV reflects uncertainty being priced into options. When IV rank hits 1.0, the options market is pricing larger-than-normal moves. Opening new positions in this environment means paying the widest bid-ask spreads and facing the highest gap risk. Waiting for IV to decline from its peak (even to 0.85) significantly improves entry quality.
